example_text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the provider shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.
hindi_equivalent: सेवा प्रदाता किसी भी क्षति के लिए उत्तरदायी नहीं होगा।
why_unfair: Completely releases provider from all liability — leaves user with zero recourse.

example_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time without prior notice. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
hindi_equivalent: हम किसी भी समय बिना सूचना के शर्तें बदल सकते हैं।
why_unfair: User cannot consent to future unknown changes; continuation-as-consent is deceptive.

example_text: All disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration. You waive your right to bring or participate in any class action lawsuit.
hindi_equivalent: सभी विवाद पंचाट द्वारा सुलझाए जाएंगे। आप अदालत में जाने का अधिकार छोड़ते हैं।
why_unfair: Waiving court rights and class action removes the most effective consumer protection mechanisms.

example_text: We may suspend or terminate your account at any time, for any reason or no reason, with or without notice.
hindi_equivalent: हम किसी भी कारण से बिना सूचना के आपका खाता बंद कर सकते हैं।
why_unfair: Allows arbitrary termination with no accountability or compensation.

example_text: By accessing or using our service, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions.
hindi_equivalent: सेवा का उपयोग करके आप इन शर्तों से सहमत हो जाते हैं।
why_unfair: User may not have read terms; passive consent is inherently unfair for significant obligations.

example_text: Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Delaware, USA.
hindi_equivalent: सभी विवादों पर केवल विदेशी अदालतों का अधिकार क्षेत्र होगा।
why_unfair: Requiring a rural Indian user to litigate in Delaware is practically impossible.
